The petitioners are before this Court calling in question proceedings in crime No.98/2014 for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 504 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

The parties to the lis were also before the Family Court in M.C.No.2901/2014 and have settled the dispute amongst themselves by drawing up certain conditions and have now filed an application under Section 320(6) of the Cr.P.C. seeking compounding of the offences.

The application insofar as the present case is concerned reads as follows:
"2. The 1st petitioner herein and 2nd respondent herein were the husband and wife,
the 2nd petitioner is the father of 1st petitioner herein.

The 2nd respondent herein was the wife of 1st petitioner and she has lodged a complaint against the petitioners before the 1st respondent police for the offences punishable under Section 498A, 506 R/W section 34 of I.P.C and Section 3 and 4 of the Dowry prohibition Act, which is pending before the XXIV Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bangalore.

sentences.text: It is submitted that by the intervention of friends and family members, the petitioners and the 2nd respondent herein have resolved the dispute between them.

Accordingly the 1st petitioner and the 2nd respondent here have filed a petition before the Hon'ble Family Court under Section 13(B) of the Hindu Marriages Act,1955, MC no.2901/2014 on the file of V Addl Family Court Judge at Bengaluru which came to allowed vide order date:26-02-2015, further it was agreed in the mediation to withdraw all the allegations."
3.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In the light of the offence being one punishable under Section 498A and 504 of the IPC and in the light of the settlement between the couple, I deem it appropriate to close the proceedings.
For the aforesaid reasons, the following ORDER 1) Criminal Petition is disposed.

2) The proceedings in C.C.No.31291/2014 pending on the file of XXIV Additional CMM Court,
Bengaluru stands quashed qua the petitioners.
